The figure places G and I on DE, with DE parallel BC. Since G is the centroid, its parallel cross-section is at one-third the altitude from BC, so DE=(2/3)BC. The incenter height is the inradius; equality with h/3 implies 3a=AB+AC+a, hence BC=a=(18+12)/2=15. Thus DE=10.
